mapper.select:
SELECT E.CompCode, E.BranchId, E.DeptCode, E.AccntId, A.AccntName, SUM(E.EstimtAmt) AS EstimtAmt, 0 AS UseAmt FROM shopion.tPrfEstimt E INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfAccnt A ON A.AccntId = E.AccntId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust C ON E.CompCode = C.CompCode AND E.BranchId = C.BranchId AND E.DeptCode = C.DeptCode WHERE C.CustId = #{pCustId}
AND E.StartDate <= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d')
AND E.EndDate >= ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY E.CompCode, E.BranchId, E.DeptCode, E.AccntId, A.AccntName

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(EstimtAmt),0) FROM shopion.tPrfEstimt E INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust C ON C.CompCode = E.CompCode AND C.BranchId = E.BranchId AND C.DeptCode = E.DeptCode WHERE C.CustId = #{custId} AND E.AccntId = #{accntId} AND E.StartDate <= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND E.EndDate >= ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfEstimt ( CompCode, BranchId, DeptCode, AccntId, StartDate, EndDate, EstimtAmt, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate ) VALUES ( #{compCode}, #{branchId}, #{deptCode}, #{accntId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{estimtAmt}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW() )
